briefHtml:
NAV S$10,270,894 — reported -0.34% (approx -0.04% real vs restated Tuesday base). Biggest verified mover among holdings: Xiaomi +2.12% to HK$25.04 Tuesday, bouncing while the memory complex crashed (KOSPI -6.2%, DRAM ETF -3%+ again). One thing: tonight's US CPI (8:30pm SGT; consensus 3.7% y/y vs 3.4% prior — last print before the Oct 27-28 FOMC) lands after NY Fed's Williams said one more 2026 hike then likely done, and after a fresh Hormuz escalation — container ship struck by a projectile, booms near Aramco's Dhahran HQ, Saudi-led strikes on Houthi oil facilities. MAS policy review + Singapore Q3 GDP this morning.

State

  • NAV S$10,270,894; reported -0.339%; listed sleeve printed -1.887% but that is contaminated by stale flag references. Oct 13 restated to 10,274,593 (from 10,278,439). NAV level authoritative.
  • FX: USD/SGD 1.2796, CNY/SGD 0.191508 (USDCNY ~6.682), HKD/SGD 0.163044, MYR/SGD 0.31332.
  • priceErrors: L46.SI Yahoo 404 — 24th consecutive session.

Flag integrity — both critical flags STALE

  • "DBS Group -5.2% in a day" (2.2% NW): false as a day move — DBS closed Tuesday at S$74.47, +0.72%. The flag echoes the Oct 8 bank rout (DBS -4.7% that day).
  • "SMIC -9.7% in a day" (1.0% NW): false as a day move — SMIC closed Tuesday at HK$55.55, -1.16%. The -9.7% is the cumulative five-session slide from Oct 6's 61.55; SMIC is ~40% below its 52-week high (93.00) — a real drawdown, not a one-day event.

Position moves (Tue Oct 13)

  • SGX second up day: STI 5,430.50 +0.28%. DBS +0.72%, OCBC +0.48%, UOB +1.06%; Singtel -0.95%.
  • HK resilient amid regional chip crash: HSI ~24,230 -0.2% while KOSPI -6.2%, Nikkei -2.0%, Taiwan -1.8%. Xiaomi 25.04 +2.12%; Tencent 425.20 -0.14%; SMIC 55.55 -1.16%.
  • US bank-earnings day: SPX 7,806 flat; Dow 51,671 -0.35%; Nasdaq -0.2%; NDX 30,569 -0.31%; VIX 15.27 +0.39%; UST 10y 5.21% (down from 5.24% — haven bid + dovish Williams); DXY 102.20 -0.4%.
  • Banks mixed, all fell: JPM rare miss, WFC mixed, GS massive revenue beat, C — JPM/GS/WFC/C/JNJ all closed lower; UNH beat. Energy top sector again (+1.75%); Healthcare worst (-1.26%).
  • Memory rout leg 3: DRAM ETF -3%+ again; NVDA -1.3%, AMD -2.3% early.
  • Metals steady: gold ~$4,182 (spot -0.3%); silver ~$60.0-60.2, drifting toward ~$59 overnight. Oil choppy: WTI +1.1%, Brent -0.5% (~$105-106); diesel futures at YTD highs; SPR 283M bbls — lowest since Oct 1982. OPEC trimmed 2026 demand growth to +0.2M bpd.

Insider (7d)

  • Wing Tai (W05.SI): two new in-window items — Change in Interest of Director on Oct 12 (with same-day Notice of Transfer of Treasury Shares; award-related acquisition) and Oct 9. Buy-equivalents; counts not disclosed in summaries.
  • None found for other held SGX names (Singtel's latest change-of-interest filings are Sep 1 — outside window). No director dealings found for Tencent/SMIC/Xiaomi; Xiaomi bought back 2M B-shares Oct 5 (buyback, not insider dealing, just outside window). US holdings are ETFs — n/a.

Congress (Oct 9-14)

  • No new STOCK Act filings appeared Oct 9-13. Most recent on file: Oct 8 batch — House Dem NJ-5 sold AMAT + MCD ($1-15K each); House Republican broad rebalance (sold SPCX/GS/C/MSFT/CSCO/MRK et al., bought SNOW/META/OKTA/GLW/CVX — sold GS and C three weeks before Tuesday's bank earnings); PA Senate Dem 2x Dell 5.6% 2033 bond buys (filed Oct 7).

Policy watch

  • CPI eve: Williams (voter) — one more 2026 hike appropriate, none in 2027, no broad price pressure outside AI and energy; Goolsbee — "AI is an inflation problem", inflation far too high. US CPI tonight 8:30pm SGT (cons 3.7% vs 3.4% prior); Warsh at IMF Friday; ASML/BAC/MS earnings Wed.
  • Hormuz escalation: container ship struck by projectile Oct 13 (UKMTO); AIS-off tanker fire; booms near Aramco HQ Dhahran; Houthis warn Aramco workers to evacuate; Saudi-led coalition hit Houthi oil facilities (Ras Issa, Bajil, Dhamar); IRGC "counting down the days" to sink US ships.
  • Trump: Iran decision "very soon"; "I might" ask Turkey to join Yemen response; Axios — Netanyahu/Trump discussed joint strike on Iranian military/nuclear targets before elections, "go ahead and get ready", no firm commitment.
  • Russia-Ukraine: Trump working with both sides, says Russia "releasing diesel to the world"; Putin-UAE call on diesel deal; next Russia-US consultations possible before year-end.
  • Trade: Bessent call with South Korea DPM; Jaishankar — India-US trade deal being finalised.
  • Asia today: Singapore Q3 GDP + MAS policy review this morning; China inflation + trade data; BoJ leans against back-to-back Oct hike (December possible).

Risk

  • Both watcher flags stale (DBS actual +0.72%; SMIC actual -1.16%) — but SMIC's five-session -9.7% slide and -40% drawdown from the 52-wk high are real.
  • Tonight's CPI is the week's binary: cons 3.7% vs 3.4% prior, 10y at 5.21%. Williams verbally capped the cycle — a hot print forces a rethink; Asia reacts first tomorrow.
  • Hormuz tail risk rising with SPR at a 44-year low; Brent ~$105-106, diesel at YTD highs.
  • Silver line: 1,777 oz at ~$60 ~ S$136.4k collateral vs S$56,240 loan; equity ~S$80.2k ~ 1.70x (~1.66x at $59.1). A -4% silver day ~ -6.7% equity.
  • FX: ~35% of NW non-SGD; USD/SGD 1.2796, dollar softening. MAS review this morning could move SGD. Cash ~62% of liquid book. L46.SI unpriced (24th session).

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • SMIC relative strength vs memory crash: fell only 1.16% Tuesday while KOSPI -6.2%; UBS/Goldman upgrades fresh; 93.7% util, 26-28% Q3 GM guide. Signal: stabilization above ~HK$55 through CPI = re-entry trigger for Asia semis leg.
  • Xiaomi divergence confirms BOM-relief thesis: +2.12% bounce while memory complex crashed on CXMT; Oct 5 buyback shows the company buying the dip. Signal: holding ~HK$24-25 while memory makes new lows = accumulation zone.
  • Energy/security: Hormuz premium underpriced (ship strike, Aramco booms, SPR 44-yr low, diesel YTD highs); Energy top SPX sector two sessions running. Duration gate CLOSED but closer — 10y 5.21%; a sub-5.20% hold after CPI arms rally-and-hold for the Defense sleeve.

trumpWatch.title: CPI eve: Williams caps the cycle verbally, Goolsbee pushes back
trumpWatch.detail: NY Fed Williams (voter): one more hike appropriate in 2026, none needed in 2027 at this time; no broad price pressure outside AI and energy — bonds rallied. Goolsbee: "AI is an inflation problem", inflation far too high. Waller: higher yields could do some of the Fed's work. US CPI tonight 8:30pm SGT (cons 3.7% y/y vs 3.4% prior); Warsh at IMF Friday; ASML/BAC/MS earnings Wednesday.

trumpWatch.title: Hormuz escalation: container ship struck, booms near Aramco HQ
trumpWatch.detail: UKMTO: container ship struck by unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz Oct 13; AIS-off tanker caught fire in eastern strait; loud booms in Dhahran near Aramco HQ; Houthis warned Aramco-facility workers to evacuate ("legitimate targets"); Saudi-led coalition struck Houthi oil facilities at Ras Issa, Bajil and Dhamar; IRGC Navy "counting down the days" to sink US ships; Iraq at highest combat readiness.

trumpWatch.title: Trump: Iran decision "very soon"; Axios reports pre-election strike talks
trumpWatch.detail: Trump spoke with the Saudi Crown Prince; "I might" ask Turkey to join the Yemen response. US official: Washington would strike Iranian ships in retaliation for any attack on a US vessel. Axios: Netanyahu and Trump discussed a major joint operation against Iranian military/nuclear targets before the elections; Trump said "go ahead and get ready" with no firm commitment; the call predated Trump's statement he would not strike Iran before the midterms.

trumpWatch.title: Russia-Ukraine: Trump says Russia "releasing diesel to the world"
trumpWatch.detail: Trump working with both sides to end the war; will update on whether Russia broke the ceasefire. Putin-UAE call covered the diesel deal. Ryabkov: next Russia-US consultations could take place before year-end.

trumpWatch.title: Trade: Bessent-South Korea call; India-US deal "being finalised"
trumpWatch.detail: Treasury Secretary Bessent held a call with South Korea's Deputy PM on shared economic priorities; Indian FM Jaishankar said India-US trade talks are heading in the right direction and a deal is being finalised.

trumpWatch.title: Asia day ahead: Singapore GDP + MAS review, China inflation/trade; BoJ pushback
trumpWatch.detail: Singapore Q3 GDP and MAS policy review land Wednesday morning SGT; China inflation and trade data due. BoJ leans against back-to-back October hikes (December possible; may shift 2% target language to "approx. 2%"). OPEC October MOMR trimmed 2026 demand growth to +0.2M bpd (2027 raised to ~2.6M bpd); US SPR unchanged at 283M bbls — lowest since Oct 1982.

opportunities.thesis: Relative strength vs the memory crash: fell only 1.16% Tuesday while KOSPI dropped 6.2% and DRAM ETFs fell 3%+ for a second day. UBS (Buy, TP 96.20) and Goldman (Buy, TP 153) upgrades are fresh; 2Q26 printed 93.7% utilization with Q3 GM guided 26-28%. Stock ~40% below its 93.00 52-week high.
opportunities.signal: Continued stabilization above ~HK$55 through tonight's CPI = re-entry trigger for the Asia-barbell semis leg.

opportunities.thesis: Divergence confirms BOM-relief thesis: +2.12% bounce Tuesday while the global memory complex crashed on CXMT's denser-cell progress (server memory by end-2026 = input-cost relief). Company repurchased 2M B-shares Oct 5 — buying its own dip.
opportunities.signal: Holding the ~HK$24-25 base while memory names make new lows = accumulation zone.
